reading_note: The teaching describes how the regenerating mind (the "second field") is cultivated by two great heavenly principles — love and wisdom in their celestial form — which work upon the soul from above, drawing her by influx into the likeness of the Divine. The arc moves from the soul as ground prepared for sowing, through the operation of the celestial luminaries upon her, to her ascent into the upper region of heaven wherever she has been inwardly received. It is a teaching on the elevation of the soul through the cooperative influx of the two great heavenly goods.

segments.spiritual_sense: {0} The second cultivated ground is the regenerating soul herself, the very mind made living by reception of good, {1} which has been purified {2} — this second field of tillage is the living soul, the {3} interior mind made receptive to heavenly seed.

key_correspondences.spiritual: the second, interior plane of the mind prepared for regeneration
the soul made living by reception of good and truth from the Lord

segments.spiritual_sense: she being established and held firm within the whole interior region of the upper heavens and the {4} celestial expanse {5} — set in that order which belongs to the heavenly degree above the natural.

key_correspondences.spiritual: the spiritual heaven, the interior region of orderly states above the natural mind
fixed in the order of heaven by influx

segments.spiritual_sense: Of those who till and cultivate her — those exalted above her are these two great {6} principles {7}, the two heavenly cultivators set higher than the soul they work upon.

key_correspondences.spiritual: agents of regeneration; the goods and truths of heaven that till the mind
operating from a higher degree by influx
the dual celestial principles of love (good) and wisdom (truth)

segments.spiritual_sense: the two great lumin{8}aries which stand fixed in the heavens, exalted in their degree, performing the work of cultivation — that is, the sun and moon of heaven, the celestial good of love and the spiritual truth of faith, ceaselessly working upon the soul as upon a field.

key_correspondences.spiritual: the celestial good (sun) and spiritual truth (moon) of the heavens
performing the labor of regeneration upon the soul

segments.spiritual_sense: they labor over her, so that she may be moved toward the likeness, that her affections {9} may be turned and drawn toward what is heavenly, {10} conformed to the image of the Divine.

key_correspondences.spiritual: the image of the Lord, the heavenly form impressed upon the regenerate soul
influx of heavenly love and truth turning the affections

segments.spiritual_sense: and so being drawn upward, ascending out of the lower into the higher, that she may come unto the Height, and may go forth {11} into the upper place {12} — that is, that she may be elevated through the degrees and pass into the celestial state {13}.

key_correspondences.spiritual: elevation of the mind through the degrees by the Lord
the celestial degree, the inmost heaven

segments.spiritual_sense: in every state and place where she is inwardly received within them, and they account her as their own — wherever the soul has been taken up into the goods and truths of heaven, there she is reckoned as belonging to the heavenly order.

key_correspondences.natural: every place where she is within them
key_correspondences.spiritual: every state of reception in which the soul is conjoined with heavenly goods and truths
appropriation; she is accounted as belonging to the heavenly society
